summary: Story 3 verified. Focused Maven run (12 tests) and full mvn test (12 tests) both BUILD SUCCESS with 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. AC1-AC8 are each supported by source inspection and named executed tests, and the current docs/api-docs.md matches the implementation and the generated OpenAPI.
decisions: Handoff validation: all six run-003 input handoffs exist, parse as JSON, have expected stages, status completed and empty blockers. Code Review had no blocking findings. verification.json did not previously exist.

Command 1: mvn -Dtest=EmployeeApiDocSyncApplicationTests,OpenApiDocumentationTests test -> EmployeeApiDocSyncApplicationTests 9 run, OpenApiDocumentationTests 3 run; total Tests run: 12, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0; BUILD SUCCESS.
Command 2: mvn test -> same two classes, total Tests run: 12, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0; BUILD SUCCESS. Surefire reports are in target/surefire-reports/.

AC1: EmployeeService.findAll(department) filters with equalsIgnoreCase; departmentFilterMatchesCaseInsensitivelyAndExactly asserts ?department=IT returns the 2 matching employees (A, C), excluding HR and null-department employees.
AC2: same test asserts ?department=it returns 2 results, equivalent to IT; case-insensitivity confirmed (also covers trimmed ' IT ' per the approved trim amendment).
AC3: findAll returns all employees in insertion order when department is null; the same test asserts GET /api/employees without the parameter returns 4; getAllReturnsAnEmptyJsonArray still passes.

AC4: the service trims then returns List.of() when empty; blankAndWhitespaceDepartmentReturnEmptyListEvenWhenEmployeesExist asserts ?department= and ?department=%20%20%20 return 200 with [] while an employee exists. Controller uses @RequestParam(required = false) with no defaultValue.
AC5: departmentFilterMatchesCaseInsensitivelyAndExactly asserts ?department=Unknown returns 200 with an empty array.
AC6: the same test asserts ?department=I does not match IT (exact match, no partial matching).

AC7: postWithoutDepartmentStillSucceedsWithNullDepartment (201, null department), postWithDepartmentEchoesItAndStoresItAsGiven, postCreatesEmployeesWithIncrementingIdsAndGetReturnsThem, getByIdReturnsNotFoundForUnknownId, postRejectsBlankNameInvalidEmailAndMissingFields and postRejectsMalformedJson all pass. department has no validation annotation; GET by ID, 404 and 400 controller code is unchanged.

AC8: OpenApiDocumentationTests asserts department is a non-required string query parameter on GET /api/employees, department is a string property on Employee (properties id, name, email, department) and CreateEmployeeRequest (name, email, department), and that paths, operations and response codes are unchanged. All 3 tests pass.
AC9 (all tests pass, per requirements.json): 12 of 12 pass in both runs.

Documentation check: current docs/api-docs.md (including the human-approved Option B trims) was reviewed against EmployeeService, EmployeeController and the OpenApiDocumentationTests assertions. It documents the optional department query parameter (omitted returns all; trimmed, case-insensitive exact match; blank or unknown returns 200 with []; null departments never match), department in the GET, GET by ID and POST examples, null department when omitted, and POST department stored as given. No inconsistency found. The docs file contains no Schemas section by approved design, and the schema details are verified through OpenApiDocumentationTests.

Preservation: no source, test, doc or handoff files were modified by verification, and no Git operations were performed. Only verification.json was written. .github/instructions/verification.instructions.md is modified but pre-dates this run and is out of scope.

Limitations: the OpenAPI check is via MockMvc test assertions on /v3/api-docs, not a manual browser check of Swagger UI (test confirms the UI page is served). The docs-versus-OpenAPI comparison is by inspection, not an automated docs-sync test. Employee JSON now includes department (null when absent), an additive change noted as a compatibility risk.
